programs.title: Carnival Eats
programs.desc: Noah Cappe takes on the dill donut sundae at the South Florida Fair in West Palm Beach, a BBQ lumpia sandwich at the Washington County Fair in Utah and the cereal-infused Saturday Morning Pizza at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo.

programs.title: Carnival Eats
programs.desc: Noah Cappe visits the Washington County Fair in Utah for the Twisted Pickle Roll -- a deep-fried pickle sushi dream come true -- and has a little dessert in the desert with the Cookie Dough Dog. Then, he's off to the Clark County Fair in Nevada for Pretzel French Toast and the spicy Cheesy Carne Brick. Finally, Noah heads to the North Florida Fair in Tallahassee for their Southern Fried Softshell Sandwich, the Fiery Fiesta Funnel Cake and Grape Gems, a candy-coated fruity treat!

programs.title: Carnival Eats
programs.desc: Riverside County Fair and National Date Festival; fire fingers cartwheel and the Sonoran fire dog; palm date shake; Pensacola Interstate Fair for some Flora-Bama fun; crabby tots and the love me tender pizza; queen of funnel cakes.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Minutes away from desert trails, mountains and limitless outdoor adventures, Andrew highlights the delicious and iconic foods of Salt Lake City; classic dishes include a pastrami burger, steak tips with mole and Utah scones.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew explores Santa Fe, a town intent on preserving its culture; Native American, Spanish and Mexican traditions converge to form dishes like slow-roasted carne adovada and sopapillas.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores the signature dishes of Tahiti; he samples everything from Polynesian ceviche to freshwater shrimp coated in a sweet, coconut curry sauce.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern celebrates can't-miss local favorites in Cincinnati, Ohio, including pork schnitzel, goetta and Cincinnati chili.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern takes a culinary tour of Aruba, where the climate is as warm as the people; he indulges in local favorites such as hearty Dutch pea soup, comforting yet elegant seafood cazuela and sweet, buttery cashew cake.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores the bountiful larder and history of the Scottish Highlands, providing chefs with the building blocks for unique dishes, including lean, flavorful Highland beef, buttery shellfish, handheld meat pies, and smoked salmon.

programs.title: BBQ USA
programs.desc: Michael Symon heads to Georgia for the Rhythm and Ribs Festival, where over 60 teams are competing to find out whose BBQ is best and win over $5,000 in prizes; friends and rivals Rescue Smokers and Off The Chain BBQ are competing for awards.

programs.title: BBQ USA
programs.desc: Michael Symon gets a taste of Kansas City-style barbecue at the Olathe BBQ Competition in Olathe, Kan., where 70 teams battle the elements and tough competition for the $10,000 prize.

programs.title: BBQ USA
programs.desc: Michael Symon heads to the Lone Star State to see teams put their barbecue to the test at Cedar Fest, in which the teams compete in ribs, chicken, pork and the star of the show, brisket.
